description: Kofi Asante (patient identifier: BAH000024) is a 35-year-old male presenting with fever for 4 days, chills, headache, and fatigue. He recently returned from a rural farming area in Western Kenya. The attending clinician suspects malaria or typhoid fever. Access Bahmni at https://localhost/bahmni/home (login: superman / Admin123). Complete the integrated clinical-lab workflow: (1) create a clinical OPD encounter documenting the presenting complaint and suspected diagnosis, (2) order laboratory investigations (at minimum: Full Blood Count/CBC and a parasitological test such as Malaria Rapid Diagnostic Test or Blood Film for Malaria), (3) navigate to the Bahmni Lab module and enter the lab results for the tests ordered (CBC results should include hemoglobin and white cell count; the malaria RDT/blood film result should be positive), (4) based on the positive malaria result, update the encounter diagnosis to confirmed Malaria and prescribe appropriate antimalarial treatment (e.g., Artemether-Lumefantrine, Artesunate, or Quinine). All four steps must be completed for full credit.
